title: Min Cost Climbing Stairs
pattern: DP: cheapest way to stand on each step
statement: `cost[i]` is the price of stepping on stair `i`. After paying it you may climb **one or two** stairs. You may start on stair 0 or stair 1. Return the minimum total cost to reach the top (the floor just past the last stair).

example.why: Start on stair 1 (pay 15), jump to stair 3 (pay 5), then jump over stair 4 to the top: 15 + 5 = 20.

idea: Let `dp[i]` be the cheapest total for **standing on stair i** (its own cost included).
You arrive on stair `i` from stair `i − 1` or stair `i − 2`. Come from whichever was cheaper, then pay `cost[i]`: `dp[i] = min(dp[i − 1], dp[i − 2]) + cost[i]`.
The top is reached from either of the last two stairs for free, so the answer is the smaller of their totals.

complexity.spaceWhy: The dp array (two variables would be enough, since only the last two entries are used).

steps.text: Our example: **`cost = [10,15,20,5,30]`**. Each step runs one highlighted line of the code.
`dp[i]` will hold the cheapest total cost to be standing on stair i.

views.title: dp[i] = cheapest total to stand on stair i

steps.text: You may start on stair 0: the only cost is the stair itself, 10.

views.title: dp[i] = cheapest total to stand on stair i

steps.text: You may also start directly on stair 1: cost 15.

views.title: dp[i] = cheapest total to stand on stair i

steps.text: Stair 2 is reached from stair 1 (total 15) or stair 0 (total 10). Come from the cheaper one and pay this stair: 10 + 20 = **30**.

views.title: dp[i] = cheapest total to stand on stair i

steps.text: Stair 3 is reached from stair 2 (total 30) or stair 1 (total 15). Come from the cheaper one and pay this stair: 15 + 5 = **20**.

views.title: dp[i] = cheapest total to stand on stair i

steps.text: Stair 4 is reached from stair 3 (total 20) or stair 2 (total 30). Come from the cheaper one and pay this stair: 20 + 30 = **50**.

views.title: dp[i] = cheapest total to stand on stair i

steps.text: The top lies just past the last stair. It can be reached from stair 4 (total 50) or from stair 3 (total 20) without paying anything more. The cheaper one: **20**.

steps.text: Done — the answer is **`20`**. Start on stair 1 (pay 15), jump to stair 3 (pay 5), then jump over stair 4 to the top: 15 + 5 = 20.
